sample: the existing stratified 150-case nvBench-2.0 development holdout
population_estimand: the fixed 720-record development population after the 30-case engineering screen
candidate_eligibility: at least one retained source occurrence is both Vega-Lite renderer executable and study-registered benchmark-normal-form compliant

pool_variants.all_taf_eligible: eligible canonical union of all twelve generation sources
pool_variants.leave_self_out: for each reranker, remove its source contributions and retain a candidate only if at least one eligible non-self source remains

ordering.baseline: RRF with k0=60 over eligible source ranks and canonical-key tie breaking
ordering.required_output_length: exactly min(5, pool size) distinct existing IDs

secondary_metrics: self-source ancestry of the selected top one
interpretation: post-review sensitivity analysis; no external or untouched-set generalization claim
